title: feat(server): add experimental support for React Server Components and Next.js app directory
body:
Took a lot of inspiration from https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-nextjs

However I found that if we call `use` only server-side without a `<Suspense>` boundary, we can completely render the page on the server without needing JS to swap the `<template>` tags like it does in their Client Components examples. We'll still have to see with Meta DevRel if it's okay to do 😅

The way I see it, it could be packaged as:

* Either a stable or beta version of React InstantSearch which supports RSC, basically just the code calling `use` in `useWidget` and probably a new context.
* A package for Next.js which would expose a component based on `<InstantSearch>`, which would also take care of injecting the initial results by directly importing the context from `next/navigation`, and retrieving them when client-side.

Users would simply have to use something like `<NextInstantSearch>` instead of `<InstantSearch>`, with the exact same options.
